# Red Cell Solutions

> Red Cell Solutions is a physical penetration testing and red team security firm. We help companies protect against corporate espionage, insider threats, social engineering, and physical break-ins by testing their people, buildings, and processes the way a real attacker would.

Core thesis: We find the way they would get in, then help you shut it down.

## Who we help
- Fortune 500 and enterprise leadership (C-suite)
- General Counsel and legal teams
- Corporate and global security directors

## Services
1. Physical Penetration Testing & Red Teaming — covert building entry, badge cloning and access-control bypass, tailgating, guard bypass, and server room / data center penetration, with photo evidence and fixes.
2. Social Engineering Testing (Phishing, Vishing & Pretexting) — phishing and spear-phishing email tests, phone (vishing) and text scams, in-person impersonation, executive protection, and security awareness training.
3. Insider Threat & Corporate Espionage Defense — insider threat assessments and programs, data-theft and espionage investigations, supply chain and vendor reviews, employee offboarding and access reviews, and ongoing monitoring.

Related terms people search for: physical penetration testing, penetration testing company, red team assessment, social engineering testing, phishing testing, vishing, pretexting, insider threat assessment, corporate espionage, corporate counterintelligence, security risk assessment, physical security consultant, tailgating test, badge cloning.

## How we work
Reconnaissance, then a live attack, then a plain-language debrief, then hardening. We retest until you are the hard target.

## Industries
Our services are industry-agnostic, with dedicated guidance for houses of worship: church security assessments, safety team training, and active-threat planning at https://redcellsolutions.com/church/.
